Specification: This module is a small TLC-oriented test specification for predicate logic and CHOOSE expressions rather than a distributed algorithm or transition protocol. It declares a single boolean variable x with a trivial behavior: Init sets x to TRUE, Next leaves x unchanged, and the main interesting content is the state predicate Inv, which contains many IF-THEN-ELSE checks using existential and universal quantification, tuple binding, Cartesian products, arithmetic comparisons, and CHOOSE. The file is explicitly testing TLC behavior on logical formulas and selection expressions, including a commented note that one CHOOSE-based test is not expected to work because TLC does not preserve the full semantics of CHOOSE.

IF \A i \in CHOOSE j \in {{Nat}, {Int}} : \E k \in j : -1 \in k : -4 \in i THEN Print("Test 14 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 14 Failed")
